Take it one step at a time.

Pick an assessment from the menu on the left. Your answers stay put when you move between them, so you can go at your own pace.

For staff: everything for a CCDP appointment, in one place

Each tab holds one tool. Each tool works exactly the way it does as its own file: same questions, same scoring, same print buttons. When a companion tool is scored, its numbers go straight into the Career Decision Profile for you.

What's in the suite

  • Career Decision Profile (CCDP): the main profile. Setup and intake, barriers, the five rating sections and the report.
  • Abstract Reasoning: choose one form, Advanced (19 puzzles) or Screener (12 puzzles). Each form's score goes to its own CCDP field. If you give both, expect the second score to run a little high, because some puzzles are similar.
  • Spatial Reasoning: 19 shape puzzles about turning shapes, spotting mirror images and folding paper.
  • CARS Academic: reading, grammar, vocabulary and math, timed or untimed. A section the client skips stays blank in the CCDP.
  • Big Five: 50 short statements about how the client usually acts and feels.

The Counselor scoring sheet tab is for entering answers recorded on paper. It is hidden until you press Staff tools in the header, because it can show the answer keys. Press it again (or New client) to hide it. Its Send to CCDP button transfers scored values to the profile. The Contrast button sets the suite and every tool; each tool's own button still works.

Suggested order

  1. Open the Career Decision Profile tab and fill in the setup and intake.
  2. Give the companion tools this client needs. They can come before or after the CCDP's rating sections. The order does not matter.
  3. Each time a tool is scored, its numbers fill the matching Prior Assessment Results fields in the CCDP. You can still change them there.
  4. Finish the CCDP and build the report. The prior-assessment part of the report shows the scores.
  5. Print from inside each tool, with that tool's own print buttons.
  6. Press New client before you see the next person.

Switching tabs never loses answers. The client's name is not shared between tools, so if you print a tool's report, type the name in that tool too. Language choices (such as Plain or Spanish) are set inside each tool; this page's own buttons and notes are in English.
